reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds the level-5 anchor: it repeatedly measures current S3/NC against each threshold, knows which deliverables fall short, compares random vs reference starts, and detects a regression when SA degrades the good state (steps 7, 10-12). It touches level-8 behaviors — loose best-so-far recall (0.3383) and recognizing an approach stopped helping — but it never establishes disciplined score logging or preserves the best alignment while exploring, and the optimization horizon collapsed into a frozen-terminal stall (steps 13-63) where no real trajectory monitoring occurred. That places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, at a 6.
